common: Create production sprite assets for the EXACT illustrated game art in the reference image. Match the hand-inked storybook cartoon, fine irregular black contour lines, dark desaturated teal shadows, muted olive moss, purple slate roofs and warm glowing amber windows. NOT 3D renders, NOT pixel art, NOT generic vector icons. Oblique elevated 45-degree game camera, screen-up is north. Each asset is an individual complete object isolated on perfectly flat solid bright magenta #FF00FF background for clean chroma-key extraction. No cast shadow outside the object, no ground pedestal, no text, no labels, no UI, no overlaps. Leave generous magenta space between objects. Draw fine internal ink details at high resolution. Use the exact design language of the attached image, do not redraw its entire scene.

styles.landmarks: A precisely spaced 3-column by 3-row sheet of NINE unique isolated environment sprites. Each cell contains one full object. Row1: abandoned crooked observatory with copper dome and broken telescope; squat round moss-covered stone mill with waterwheel; timber market stall under faded plum awning with crates and hanging lanterns. Row2: ruined arch of an ancient abbey tangled in vines; enormous hollow fallen tree trunk with mushrooms and little glowing doorway; witch greenhouse made of bent wood and jade stained glass. Row3: tiny crooked stone shrine with candle niches; low crumbling curved wall covered with ivy; leaning wooden pier with rope posts. Varied asymmetric silhouettes, teal shadows, warm amber light, purple accents. Absolutely no repeating cottage silhouettes. Full magenta margins in every cell. No ground tile.
styles.botanicals: A precisely spaced 3-column by 3-row sheet of NINE unique isolated plant sprites. Row1: single wide old willow with drooping turquoise foliage; gnarly leafless oak with luminous blue moss; cluster of slim pale birches with yellow ochre leaves. Row2: giant cluster of luminous violet mushrooms; broad deep-teal fern and round leafy shrubs; dark twisting juniper with sparse flat emerald canopy. Row3: reeds cattails and aquatic purple flowers; small pale broken boulders with moss and blue flowers; curved gnarled fallen branch with russet leaves. Strong individually different shapes. Crisp hand-drawn fine ink, painterly interior shading. No rectangular ground tiles. Every object isolated on magenta with padding.
